notes.title: New Movement Mechanics for Characters
notes.content:
[url=https://ibb.co/tp5V4xjg][img]https://i.ibb.co/MkLFsGwr/Climb-Dog.png[/img][/url]

Now the island creatures can Dash and Grab onto walls to move through the levels, making the game more dynamic and allowing you to take different paths based on your playstyle.

[url=https://ibb.co/039mDQC][img]https://i.ibb.co/8VxNKXr/Dash-Dog.png[/img][/url]

The levels have been adjusted to support dashing and wall climbing with your character.

notes.title: Carnival has arrived on the island of animals.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/27Jvz5NZ/screenshot-carnaval.png[/img]

Carnival has arrived, and themed decorations are spread throughout the stages, so check out the masks and confetti to brighten up your gameplay.

The King Vulture stage has also been improved with challenges that test your reflexes and flying skills with your character.

notes.title: Portal to next level
notes.content: Added Portal to teleport to next level.

notes.title: New look for the game's home screen
notes.content: new structure of the game's home menu

notes.title: New effects in Game
notes.content: Game background improvements and wind effect on trees and grass interaction with the player

notes.title: Update 1 - New Boss and more levels
notes.content:
10 new levels from 31 to 40: Now you have 10 new levels to adventure, and at level 40 a new boss is ready to test your skills.

1 new boss MechaBull: He is a high-tech robot used to monitor João Meat's farms, you will be the first to test the full power of MechaBull, so be careful with this robot's jumps and horns.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/v09X3ZX.png[/img]

Adjustment of the game's pause menu: the old version was less intuitive and lacks the button to go to the menu. So these modifications were made to improve the navigation of the game's interface.

Control adjustment: Xbox and Playstation controls now work without non-standard button inputs.

notes.title: Path 0.1
notes.content: Small adjustments in the first phase of the adventure. And blue sky on the menu.
